liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Estimated Prophet** (3 reviews): Jerry uses funky MIDI effects in the jam coming out of Estimated Prophet; MIDI flute jamming in the transition from Estimated into Eyes is singled out as excellent [20][21][30]
- **Eyes of the World** (1 review): Mickey and Billy drum hard going into a fast Eyes that launches cleanly [20]
- **Stella Blue** (1 review): Reviewer finds Stella Blue exceptionally strong [21]
- **Let the Good Times Roll** (1 review): Works as an opener because the three main vocalists trade verses [22]
- **Victim or the Crime** (1 review): Reviewer likes the eerie feeling of Victim Or The Crime [22]
- **Iko Iko** (1 review): Iko Iko is full of energy, with the crowd very into it [27]

## Setlist highlights

- **gd89-10-15 s1t01 Crowd**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [31]
- **gd89-10-15 s1t02 Let The Good Times Roll**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [31]
- **gd89-10-15 s1t03 Iko Iko**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [31]
- **gd89-10-15 s1t04 Walkin' Blues**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [31]
- **gd89-10-15 s1t05 Far From Me**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [31]
- **gd89-10-15 s1t06 Row Jimmy**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [31]
- **gd89-10-15 s1t07 Victim Or The Crime**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [31]
- **gd89-10-15 s1t08 Standing On The Moon**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [31]

## The recordings

- **gd1989-10-15.142542.fob.schoeps.cmc4.mk4.mattes.miller.clugston.flac1648** (recommended): audience recording; 22 songs; 161 min [1]
- **gd1989-10-15.senn421.andrewf.89674.sbeok.flac16**: source not stated; 21 songs; 152 min; rated 3.33/5 by 3 [2]
- **gd1989-10-15.sbd.walker-scotton.miller.83298.sbeok.flac16**: soundboard; 19 songs; 160 min; rated 3.86/5 by 7 [3]
- **gd1989-10-15.147666.UltraMatrix.sbd.cm.miller.flac16**: soundboard; 19 songs; 159 min [4]
- **gd89-10-15.sbd.chaser.3159.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 17 songs; 145 min; rated 4.25/5 by 4 [15]. Said about its sound: Reviewer says the soundboard's quality is good and could be better, but is fine; Reviewer calls the soundboard sound excellent, and says most of the show rocks [19][20]

## Around the show

- Reviewer of the matrix hears band energy as somewhat low overall, despite MIDI guitar effects [28]
- Reviewer dislikes the faster 1980s Eyes in general, but this one wins them over [21]
- Reviewer finds the first set better than the second, unusual for an 1989 show [27]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1989-10-15.142542.fob.schoeps.cmc4.mk4.mattes.miller.clugston.flac1648**: taped by Ted Mattes; transferred by Scott Clugston and Charlie Miller; source: flac16/48kHz ; Source Info: Ted Mattes' Master (FOB)Audience Dat; Schoeps CMC4/MK4 mics @ 110 degrees, ORTF, Schoeps t-bar, hand held, chin high > Monster… [1]
- **gd1989-10-15.senn421.andrewf.89674.sbeok.flac16**: taped by Andrew F.; transferred by Andrew F.; source: Sennheiser MD-421's > patched thru one D5 > Sony TC-D5M > Maxell MX-90's, with no Dolby. Mics on 8-foot stand, front row of OTS [2]. Also: Tape flips in Standing On The Moon and the Jam were crossfaded or mended together; Edited in Soundforge for fades, cleanup and levels; released in memory of Adam Katz [2]
- **gd1989-10-15.sbd.walker-scotton.miller.83298.sbeok.flac16**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD -> Cassette Master (TDK MA-XG90) D [3]. Also: Soundboard came from tapes by Paul Scotton and Joani Walker, via Nakamichi decks to cassette master, then CD; A patch source recorded by Steve Cherson covers the Row Jimmy to Victim Or The Crime area [3]
- **gd1989-10-15.147666.UltraMatrix.sbd.cm.miller.flac16**: taped by Don Pearson; transferred by Charlie Miller; source: UltraMatrix SBD > Cassette Master (TDK MA-XG90) [4]. Also: Ted Mattes's Schoeps DAT patches part of Standing On The Moon; Charlie Miller handled all transfers and mastering; Two sets of masters were combined to make the second set complete [4]
- **gd89-10-15.sbd.chaser.3159.sbeok.shnf**: source: SBD> C> DAT> CDR [15]

## Art and photos

- Fan art by Grateful Dead: [Grateful Dead Meadowlands Arena - October 16, 1989](https://www.dead.net/show/october-16-1989) [33]
- Fan art by LiveGRATEFUL.net: [Grateful Dead 1989-10-15 Sun Meadowlands Arena, East Rutherford, NJ](https://www.livegrateful.net/post/1416452242073/grateful-dead-1989-10-15-sun-meadowlands) [34]
- Poster by Kirsten Michel: [1989-10-15 Meadowlands Arena, East Rutherford, NJ, USA - Jerry Garcia](https://jerrygarcia.com/show/1989-10-15-meadowlands-arena-east-rutherford-nj-usa/) [35]
